items.alt: A caretaker sweeps the red carpets of the vast Mosque–Madrasa of Sultan Ḥasan in Cairo, light falling across the stone walls.
items.title: Cinderello
items.note: A man was sweeping the carpets, and the light caught the dust just right.

items.alt: A Nubian woman in a bright headscarf laughing as she plays a frame drum in front of an ochre wall.
items.title: Frame Drum
items.note: She couldn’t stop laughing while she played.
items.award: Winner · National Photography Competition for Kids

items.alt: A woman in Day of the Dead calavera face paint, a crown of red roses and a red dress, at night.
items.title: Día de los Muertos
items.note: Calavera face paint, red roses and a red fan at the Day of the Dead celebration.
items.award: Winner · National Photography Competition for Kids

items.alt: A black cat walking across a patterned mosque carpet.
items.title: Visitor
items.note: A black cat crossing the patterned prayer carpet.

items.alt: A bright red Nubian house with a blue arched door.
items.title: Blue Door
items.note: A red house and an arched blue door in full sun.

items.alt: Two king penguins standing side by side on grass.
items.title: You’ve Got Me
items.note: Two king penguins who have each other’s backs.
